title: modiolastrum malvifolium
intro: Modiolastrum malvifolium, commonly known as False Mallow, is a plant species within the Malvaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to treat fever, cough, and digestive issues due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Modiolastrum malvifolium are attributed to its antioxidant, antispasmodic, and expectorant properties, which help to soothe respiratory issues and calm digestive discomfort. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
